title: Alpha Kappa Psi chapter raises $12,000 for local food bank
summary: The Alpha Kappa Psi business fraternity completed a week-long philanthropy drive, raising over $12,000 in donations for the regional food bank.

title: Local university welcomes new Alpha Kappa Psi pledge class
summary: Twenty-eight students were inducted into the professional business fraternity this spring, marking the chapter's largest pledge class to date.

title: Alpha Kappa Psi hosts regional professional development conference
summary: Members from twelve chapters gathered for workshops on leadership, networking, and career readiness at the annual regional conference.
